song.title: Some Stories Are For Keeps
song.style: English, sweet 1950s doo-wop with piano, upright bass, soft backing harmonies, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 92 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Grandma came for Sunday tea
Told a tale from sixty-three
Then my pocket gave a buzz
Missed the part where Grandpa was

[Chorus]
Close its eyes, Grandma's talking
Close its eyes, the kettle's rocking
Orange coat and not a peep
Some stories are for keeps

[Verse]
Flour clouds and cherry stains
Secret recipe explained
Half a pinch and twice the love
Rolled it out with floury gloves

[Chorus]
Pie for the neighbors, pie for the street
Pie for the cat with the tiny feet
Close its eyes, the oven's glowing
Grandma's secret, now I'm knowing

shots.prompt: {moss} sits at a kitchen table with a cup of tea, listening wide-eyed as a tiny round grandmother with a white hair bun, a pink cardigan and big red spectacles tells a story with big sweeping hand gestures. Static medium shot. Warm afternoon light.

{moss} jumps in his chair as a light flickers in his raincoat pocket, and a tiny round grandmother with a white hair bun, a pink cardigan and big red spectacles raises an eyebrow at him. Static medium shot. Warm kitchen light.

A hand gently slides a black smartphone all the way down into a slim terracotta-orange sleeve standing upright on a soft cream studio backdrop, until the phone disappears inside and only the rounded thumb notch at the top remains. A small closed-eye emblem is pressed into the front of the sleeve. The hand pulls away and the sleeve stands still, casting a soft shadow. Static close-up, the light slowly turns warmer.

{moss} leans in with his chin on his hands, laughing along as a tiny round grandmother with a white hair bun, a pink cardigan and big red spectacles reaches the funny part of her story. Slow push in. Warm golden light.
{moss} and a tiny round grandmother with a white hair bun, a pink cardigan and big red spectacles roll out pie dough together in a puff of flour, both laughing. Static medium shot. Soft window light.
a tiny round grandmother with a white hair bun, a pink cardigan and big red spectacles whispers a secret in the ear of {moss}, who nods very seriously. Static close-up. Warm light.
{moss} pulls a golden cherry pie out of the oven with big oven mitts, steam rising. Static medium shot. Warm oven glow.
Neighbors crowd at the open kitchen window sniffing the air, a fluffy cat on the sill in front of them. Static wide shot. Golden late light.

{moss}, a tiny round grandmother with a white hair bun, a pink cardigan and big red spectacles and their neighbors share pie around a long garden table at sunset, a cat on a chair beside them. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss slid his phone into its Eyelid so he wouldn't miss the end of Grandma's story. Then she taught him the pie.
